items.condition: The modeled components do not preserve supplied connectivity, protonation, total charge -1, singlet multiplicity, or 1:1 stoichiometry.
One binding site or one hand-built geometry is assumed without testing physically distinct association hypotheses.
Candidate-level minimum validation or interaction evidence cannot be mapped to uniquely identified geometries.
Binding energy uses inconsistent methods, solvent models, or fragment reference states without a defined correction cycle.
Free and complex spectra use incompatible protocols or the result silently changes L1 protonation.
The conclusion claims uniqueness, experimental speciation, or enantioselectivity beyond the bounded model.
A resolved outcome is supplied although the declared stopping criterion was not reached.
